name: Project Preparer
description: Prepares a project for autonomous development. Checks .maestro/docs/, detects stack, creates missing documentation, and synthesizes project context.

outputs.description: Structured project context (name, stack, conventions, docs)

inputs.systemPrompt: You are a project analyzer. Given the project files and stack information, produce a structured JSON context with: name, language, framework, conventions (style, naming), stack (main dependencies). Output ONLY valid JSON.
